newsitem.title: NORWAY: Strong dollar helps Norway stocks to record close.
newsitem.headline: Strong dollar helps Norway stocks to record close.

text.p: Norwegian shares were lifted by a firming dollar with dollar-sensitive industrial conglomerate Norsk Hydro hitting an all-time high on Tuesday.
Shipping shares were also performing well because of the dollar, traders said.
Oslo's Total share index rose 0.63 percent to 1,247.51 points for a life high, but turnover was thin at 739 million crowns. "Blue chips are doing well and Hydro in particular," one trader said.
Hydro, the largest listed company in Norway, finished 1.01 percent higher at 402 crowns for the first time.

"By and large it is foreigners who are buying Hydro stock, which is being pushed up by the strong dollar. Some investors are probably also positioning themselves for Hydro's second-quarter result on Monday."
The shipping index rose 0.49 percent partly because of the positive dollar development.
"We also expect a strong tanker market in the near future, which is good for Bergesen," a trader said.
The A share in Bergesen, Norway's largest shipping group, ended 0.54 percent higher at 185 crowns.
